text:
marie: quick q — for the new privileged_cutoff flag (the global kill-switch for expensive inference paths) who is allowed to flip it in an emergency? need to update the runbook and make sure audit/logging covers it.

alex: currently my understanding: eng-oncall (primary), eng-sre oncall (secondary). security ops should be notified immediately. product/pm cannot toggle. implementation detail lives in infra/runbooks but we should make it explicit. :point_up:

sophia: does the toggle action include an authenticated audit entry with identity + reason + ticket? where is that stored (kafka/audit-log/api)?

jamal: it should. right now flag changes are emitted to the audit topic and to CloudTrail-like events in our log pipeline. but we don't enforce structured "reason" field — it's freeform.

mike: i'd push to require a reason and ticket id for any manual flip. we can make the CLI/console require `--reason` and `--ticket` when user_role in [eng-oncall, eng-sre]. small snippet we can add to the ops CLI: 

```
redwoodctl flag set privileged_cutoff off --reason "production OOM spike" --ticket RT-1234
```

alex: agree. also add a short cooldown: only flip once per 5m and create an incident if flipped. avoids flip-flap.

marie: good call. how about who can un-flip? same group + must have incident marked resolved and an owner?

jamal: yes — un-flip requires the incident to be in a resolved state and a follow-up postmortem link. enforcement can be in the flag-service: check incident API status before allowing `on`.

security-bot: NOTE: policy "privileged-flag-change" requires MFA and is logged to `audit.events.privileged_flags` (streaming to sec-team).

alex: ops action items: 1) require `--reason` + `--ticket` in redwoodctl and console UI; 2) emit structured audit JSON with actor, role, reason, ticket, cfg_before, cfg_after; 3) require MFA for toggle (security team to enable); 4) add 5m cooldown. i'll file PRs.

sophia: i'll update the runbook text and add the list of allowed roles + escalation matrix (oncall -> eng-sre -> security -> eng leadership). will link runbook here when done.

marie: thanks. small UX question: for oncall flipping, do we want an automated broadcast to #incidents and to the customer CMs when relevant?

mike: yes broadcast to #incidents and to the impacted product channel. avoid customer pings unless major. we can add a checkbox in the incident form.

deploy-bot: FLAG_CHANGE event: privileged_cutoff toggled OFF by alex at 1932104618 (reason: "production OOM spike", ticket: RT-1234) — audit id a0b9c3

marie: perfect. sophia pls paste the runbook link once updated. i'll add this as the canonical procedure and follow up with compliance to update retention. :white_check_mark:
